text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Exact subspace geometry | rotated directions, unchanged spectrum
Top: actual 12 x 12 orthogonal projectors in ECG-lead coordinates, with a shared scale. Bottom: principal angles and covariance descriptors from actual matrices.
C = A A^T; signed covariance = S C S. Spectrum curves overlap by design; principal-angle roundoff can produce numerical-near-zero angles.
No literal low-dimensional plane or physical hardware is implied. Standard rank 8 includes six unconstrained precordial coordinates plus ideal limb relationships.
